description: finance_fire — FIRE / financial-independence calculator: FI number from annual expenses and safe withdrawal rate (plus lean/fat FI), years and age to FI from current savings + annual savings at a real return, Coast FI number, savings needed to retire by a target age, SWR table and a yearly trajectory. Params: annual_expenses (required), current_savings, annual_savings, return (real %, default 5), swr (default 4), age, retire_age (default 65), target_age. Offline. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
